title: ModifyMC
description: ModifyMC is a Network focused around Diamond SMP. You can join on any version 1.21.2+
body:
## ModifyNetwork provideds a FFA server and a Duels.
Any player on java 1.21.2+ can join using the IP modifymc.net

- Please follow our rules which you can find in [our Discord](https://discord.com/invite/modify).

- If you wish you can support us by buying the VIP rank on [our Store](https://modifymc.tebex.io/).

- Version 1.21.8 is recommended for the optimal experience.
 
_We do not represent or claim to be affiliated with Minecraft, Mojang or Microsoft._
